name: PepSpecBench
description: Benchmark for peptide MS/MS fragment intensity prediction with harmonised PROSPECT and MassIVE-KB subsets, backbone-disjoint splits, a shared canonical fragment-ion evaluation space and a cross-species out-of-distribution suite.

attributes.task: Peptide tandem mass spectrum (fragment intensity) prediction
attributes.scope_note: Peptide length 6-40, precursor charge 1-6, PTMs UNIMOD 1, 4 and 35. In-domain: PROSPECT-Mini and MassIVE-KB-Mini, 500k/50k/50k spectra each. OOD: seven 20k-spectrum subsets over five species from ProteomeXchange (MaxQuant 1% FDR); zero-shot transfer.
attributes.source_locator: Sections 3.1-3.3; Appendix C
limitations: Preprint; six models all retrained by the benchmark authors.
